## `scripts/bridge.py`

End-to-end orchestrator for the mumei ↔ mumei-lean bridge.

### Mutually exclusive groups

| Options | Required |
|---|---|
| `--cert`, `--bundle`, `--escalation-bundle`, `--ingest-bundle`, `--scan-unknown` | yes |

### Options

| Option | Value | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--cert` | `<CERT>` | no | — | Path to a single mumei .proof-cert.json. |
| `--bundle` | `<BUNDLE>` | no | — | Path to a mumei std-proof-bundle.json. |
| `--escalation-bundle, --ingest-bundle` | `<ESCALATION_BUNDLE>` | no | — | Path to a mumei escalation-bundle.json. |
| `--scan-unknown` | `<MUMEI_REPO>` | no | — | Scan <MUMEI_REPO>/std/certs for per-module certificates containing unknown atoms. |
| `--out-dir` | `<OUT_DIR>` | no | generated | Directory to emit generated Lean sources into (default: generated/). |
| `--module-prefix` | `<MODULE_PREFIX>` | no | Generated | Top-level Lean module prefix (default: Generated). |
| `--lean-cert-out` | `<LEAN_CERT_OUT>` | no | — | Where to write the resulting .lean-cert.json. Required unless --no-export is set. For --escalation-bundle, defaults to out/<bundle-stem>.lean-cert.json. |
| `--summary-json` | `<SUMMARY_JSON>` | no | — | Optional path to write a JSON summary of unknown atoms discovered (per module + names). Useful as a CI artifact when running with --scan-unknown. |
| `--lean-version` | `<LEAN_VERSION>` | no | unknown | Lean toolchain version to record in the output certificate. |
| `--no-build` | — | no | — | Skip the `lake build` step (useful for dry runs). |
| `--dual-check` | — | no | — | Also Lean-check verified Z3-unsat atoms without changing their proof status. |
| `--ci-mode` | — | no | — | CI mode: on lake build failure, fall back to --no-build and preserve generated .lean files as artifacts. |
| `--no-export` | — | no | — | Skip writing the final .lean-cert.json (implies dry run). |
| `--no-tactic-search` | — | no | — | Disable the automatic tactic search for residual obligations (docs/LEAN_TRANSLATOR_SPEC.md §12). |
| `--tactic-search-history` | `<PATH>` | no | data/tactic_search_history.json | Pinned artifact whose recorded successes deterministically re-rank the tactic search ladder (docs/LEAN_TRANSLATOR_SPEC.md §12.5). |
| `--no-tactic-search-history` | — | no | — | Probe the declared ladder order, ignoring the learned ranking. |
| `--record-tactic-search-history` | — | no | — | Write this run's adopted tactics back into the pinned history artifact so the next run probes them first. |
| `--tactic-search-timeout` | `<SECONDS>` | no | 300.0 | Per-obligation wall-clock budget for the automatic tactic search (default: 300s). |
| `--failure-report` | `<PATH>` | no | — | Where to write the structured per-atom build failure JSON (default: <out-dir>/lake_build_failures.json). |
| `--external-proofs` | `<PATH>` | no | — | JSON file of caller-supplied tactic scripts / witness lemmas (e.g. mumei-agent AI proofs) injected as proof bodies of the regenerated statements (docs/LEAN_TRANSLATOR_SPEC.md §13). Promotion still requires `lake build` and the export gates. |
| `--repo-dir` | `<REPO_DIR>` | no | . | mumei-lean repo root used as the lake working directory (default: this repo). |

## `scripts/export_cert.py`

Emit a mumei-compatible .lean-cert.json from a lake build run.

### Options

| Option | Value | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--input-cert` | `<INPUT_CERT>` | yes | — | Path to the original mumei .proof-cert.json this run is augmenting. |
| `--build-log` | `<BUILD_LOG>` | yes | — | Path to a captured `lake build` stdout/stderr log. |
| `--proved-atoms` | `<PROVED_ATOMS>` | yes | — | Path to a newline-delimited file of atom names that were emitted as Lean theorems by ingest_cert.py. |
| `--lean-version` | `<LEAN_VERSION>` | no | unknown | Lean toolchain version string to embed in the output. |
| `--out` | `<OUT>` | yes | — | Where to write the resulting .lean-cert.json. |


## `scripts/ingest_cert.py`

Translate a mumei .proof-cert.json into Lean theorem sources.

### Positional arguments

| Argument | Value | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input` | `<INPUT>` | yes | — | Path to a mumei ProofCertificate (.proof-cert.json), ProofBundle (std-proof-bundle.json), or escalation bundle. |

### Options

| Option | Value | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--bundle` | — | no | — | Force interpreting the input as a ProofBundle (otherwise auto-detected). |
| `--out` | `<OUT>` | no | generated | Output directory for generated Lean sources (default: generated/). |
| `--module-prefix` | `<MODULE_PREFIX>` | no | Generated | Top-level Lean module prefix for emitted files (default: Generated). |
| `--print-summary` | — | no | — | Print a one-line summary instead of the list of written files. |
| `--external-proofs` | `<PATH>` | no | — | JSON file of caller-supplied tactic scripts / witness lemmas injected as proof bodies (docs/LEAN_TRANSLATOR_SPEC.md §13). |


## `scripts/lean_to_executable.py`

Compile a Lean 4 executable and copy its .lean-cert.json.

### Options

| Option | Value | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--project-dir` | `<PROJECT_DIR>` | no | . | Lean/Lake project directory containing lakefile.lean. |
| `--module` | `<MODULE>` | yes | — | Lean module root used by the executable target, e.g. SimpleCli. |
| `--target` | `<TARGET>` | no | — | Lake executable target. Defaults to the kebab-case module leaf. |
| `--out-dir` | `<OUT_DIR>` | yes | — | Directory that receives the executable and .lean-cert.json. |
| `--cert` | `<CERT>` | no | — | Certificate to copy. Defaults to <project-dir>/.lean-cert.json. |
| `--binary-name` | `<BINARY_NAME>` | no | — | Optional output filename for the copied executable. |
| `--lake` | `<LAKE>` | no | lake | Lake command to invoke. |
| `--run-args` | `<RUN_ARGS> ...` | no | — | Optional smoke-test arguments to pass to the copied executable. |
| `--run-timeout` | `<RUN_TIMEOUT>` | no | 30 | Timeout in seconds for --run-args smoke test. |
